milestone.name: Canonical project guide and governed skill authoring
milestone.objective: Validate the product value and demo story using the canonical project guide, then implement the remaining guide generator.

lastCompletedWork.summary: Reviewed the product against peer impact, demo readiness, and production readiness. Confirmed the strongest story is the before-and-after journey from governed project creation to a documented working application.

decisions.decision: Give project-understanding exclusive ownership of complete repository rescans and its authoritative JSON and Markdown pair.
decisions.rationale: Current-project documentation is distinct from durable lessons and handoff continuity, and exclusive report ownership prevents conflicting producers.

decisions.decision: Require new Project Video plans to use schema 1.2 and bind current Project Understanding artifacts and digests.
decisions.rationale: Presentation content remains traceable to the exact repository scan while legacy 1.0 and 1.1 plans remain compatible.

decisions.decision: Prefer Azure Speech in the configured region, approval-gate same-cloud cross-region processing, and preserve identical pages and dialogue in browser fallback.
decisions.rationale: Azure neural narration is preferred without making regional availability or external processing mandatory; browser output remains truthfully labeled interactive HTML.

decisions.decision: Keep project-video as the exclusive production workflow owner and project-setup as the provisioning and routing owner.
decisions.rationale: This avoids duplicate action ownership while making the capability available to new and adopted projects.

decisions.decision: Accept legacy 1.0.0 plans and use schema 1.1.0 for explicit production providers, capabilities, approvals, profiles, and paths.
decisions.rationale: Existing automation remains compatible while new plans carry complete output-truth evidence.

decisions.decision: Assemble every narrated and executive video locally with FFmpeg from the VS Code workflow.
decisions.rationale: The production workflow must not depend on a separately licensed interactive video editor or leave VS Code for finishing.

decisions.decision: Make production preflight local and fail closed on missing exact capability records.
decisions.rationale: Azure availability records do not authorize external calls or costs; Azure OpenAI records real deployment/model IDs and Speech/Avatar records resource/region evidence.

decisions.decision: Resolve Azure cloud in the order explicit -Gov or -Commercial, saved profile, then Azure Commercial.
decisions.rationale: This preserves an explicit sovereign-cloud choice while providing a deterministic product default.

decisions.decision: Persist nonsecret Azure environment choices in ignored .azure/environment.json and reuse them without repeated questions.
decisions.rationale: Cloud, subscription, region, authentication method, and MCP policy are environment state rather than per-operation prompts.

decisions.decision: Support interactive device-code and managed-identity authentication only in the distributable automation.
decisions.rationale: Secret-based service-principal command construction would violate the credential-free scaffold security contract.

decisions.decision: Keep Azure MCP disabled by default and gate foundryextensions on an already-recorded client ID.
decisions.rationale: Unconfigured optional namespaces must not open recurring OAuth registration dialogs.

decisions.decision: Skills own skill-named slash actions; prompt files retain only prompt-specific and help commands.
decisions.rationale: One action owner removes duplicate names and ambiguous command routing.

decisions.decision: Treat the 41 skills as optional building blocks and user reference material rather than a curriculum users must learn.
decisions.rationale: Users need to know the range of available capabilities and can reuse or adapt individual skills when a project situation calls for them.

decisions.decision: Offer the core profile as the lightweight governance entry point and explain durable controls by the risk they address.
decisions.rationale: Small teams can start with essential clarification, validation, and ownership controls while adding continuity, recovery, and Azure audit capabilities when their operating risk justifies them.

decisions.decision: Position the tool as the starting point for every project, not as the application builder.
decisions.rationale: Creation establishes the governed workspace and empty application boundaries; Copilot and the user build the application afterward.

decisions.decision: Make Project Video show the actual completed project through evidence-backed content and, where available, project screenshots or live workflow views.
decisions.rationale: A strong demo must show the before-and-after journey from governed baseline to working project, not only a generic architecture animation.

decisions.decision: Keep Azure Speech optional and provide a no-cost local narration path for standard demos.
decisions.rationale: Azure improves voice quality when approved and available, while a built-in local voice fallback preserves reproducible demos without cloud credentials or usage charges.

decisions.decision: Make documentation-builder the authoritative producer of docs/PROJECT-GUIDE.md and reports/project-guide.json.
decisions.rationale: Project Video, LinkedIn Post, and future management presentations need one evidence-bound project narrative while retaining current-code freshness checks.

decisions.decision: Route every request to create or define a skill through skill-create, including indirect wording.
decisions.rationale: The authoring workflow must compare existing capabilities, report similar or duplicate skills, and reuse existing skills before creating another contract.

decisions.decision: Use the canonical project guide as the shared narrative source for project video, social posts, and future management presentations.
decisions.rationale: One evidence-bound narrative reduces drift while downstream outputs can still verify freshness against current code and reports.

decisions.decision: Demo the complete lifecycle: create the governed foundation, build a visible application feature, validate it, generate the guide, and produce the project presentation.
decisions.rationale: This demonstrates measurable workflow impact more convincingly than showing the framework file tree alone.

validation.check: Focused contract, adoption, and project-video tests
validation.evidence: 68 tests passed, 0 failed, including fresh handoff creation, one-round clarification propagation, canonical guide references, and mandatory skill-create routing.
Security, release build, and unsigned release-candidate verification passed; the long integration suite exceeded the execution timeout and was stopped before a final exit status.
41 of 41 skills passed registry-free distribution verification.

Regression coverage validates complete atomic rescans, secret-file exclusion, inventories, schema strictness, eight understanding-derived pages, digest binding, browser parity, and stale-artifact rejection.
Contract tests reject prompt basenames that collide with canonical skill names.
Recognized framework-owned duplicate prompts are removed transactionally; unrecognized project-owned collisions fail as conflicts.
The scaffold contains no tenant, subscription, client-secret, password, or service-principal credential material.
Regression coverage validates exact Azure capability identifiers, externalWorkAuthorized false, FFmpeg assembly, portable MP4 delivery, and complete Avatar segment-to-asset mappings.

worktree.attribution: This handoff attributes the canonical project-guide contract, skill-create routing, one-round clarification policy, fresh new-project handoff, related tests and synchronized reports. Remaining modified inventory and security reports are generated evidence from validation.

blockers: Production distribution requires current-commit Windows, Linux, and macOS evidence for Node 22, 24, and 26.
Production distribution requires trusted signature and independent-review evidence.
pendingApprovals: Separate approval before push, merge, publication, upload, deployment, or any Azure mutation.
limitations: No Azure OpenAI, Speech, Speech Avatar, FFmpeg rendering, package installation, login, or cloud operation was executed; behavior was validated locally.
The local Azure environment file is intentionally ignored and is created only when Azure work first requires it.
The unsigned candidate is suitable for local testing only and is not approved for production distribution.

nextAction.action: Implement the documentation-builder generator for docs/PROJECT-GUIDE.md and reports/project-guide.json, then run the end-to-end create, build, guide, and project-video demo.
prerequisites: Keep push, tag, publication, deployment, and Azure mutation out of scope.
Preserve the blocked production-release status until external evidence is available.
